verdict.rationale: doola's documented Partner API covers entity records programmatically: you can create customers, submit LLC/C-Corp formations, retrieve formation documents, read a company's compliance calendar, and file and track annual reports, with self-serve keys and a sandbox. Nothing shows registered-agent appointments being readable or manageable through the API; the only registered-agent evidence describes dashboard access to mail. missing for 10: API endpoints for reading or changing registered-agent appointments, explicit read/update of existing entity records beyond formation and compliance flows, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
